== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]]: the region (108, 844, 716, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif Holotable commit b8af2d4] (2023-05-31). The matching before crop is [[:File:V21-L-icantbelievehesgone-2023-05-31-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Playtest)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif commit 53a6001]) and [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif commit b8af2d4]).
